title: Cassandre-style lithograph poster: vermilion field, a monument from below, the title in a beam of unprinted paper (Steam capsule set)
summary: A dominant vermilion field, a monumental object seen from below that bleeds off the frame, light as a flat shape of unprinted paper with halftone dots eating its far end, the ink plate printed a few pixels out of register over a rust plate, and a title that sits in the light, tilted with it. The steam.* templates re-compose this one design for every Steam store and library size.

provenance.case: steam-capsules round 2 (远灯 FARLAMP): 13 Steam store and library assets in 12 sizes plus a store-page first screen, for an original fictional indie puzzle game.
provenance.lineage: A. M. Cassandre's 1920s-30s lithograph posters (Normandie, Étoile du Nord): monumental objects from extreme angles, flat colour fields, light as unprinted paper, airbrush and halftone gradations. Borrowed: the grammar. Never borrowed: any poster, ship, train or lettering of his.
provenance.borrow: Borrow grammar, never assets. Every shape is drawn in code; the title lettering is the bank's code-drawn lettering; the round-1 chart engraving (U.S. Coast Survey, 1854-57, The Met, CC0) only survives in the gameplay mock-ups.
provenance.rounds: Round 1 navy night sky with an amber beam passed every check and was judged 'too ordinary'; round 2 this pack. Round 2 first pass: 3 findings (two icon pages computed a negative sea height, one transparent logo); final: 1 explained (the transparent library logo, 3.88:1 where it is used, on the hero).
measured: Title ink #15151C on paper light #F2E4C4: 14.42:1; event copy paper on the sea 12.59:1.
Small capsule at the store's 120x45: re-composed title box 23.8 px (both names read by OCR) against 14.9 px for a cropped header (Latin name lost).
64 px: three assets with the title hidden still read as one game and as a printed poster, not a UI template (round 1 read as 'any lighthouse').

field.use: the dominant vermilion field; also the dots eating the beam

field_hi.use: secondary rays and the halftone glow (decoration)

paper.use: the light (unprinted paper), tower bands, text on the sea

ink.use: the title and the monument's ink plate

rust.use: the out-of-register under-plate and the title's shadow plate

sea.use: the sea band; event copy sits on it in paper

display.use: the CJK title (letter-spacing -0.02 em, cut by three beam slits) and event titles

label.use: event kickers and one-line event copy

fonts.resolve: fonts query --text "<title and copy>" --style mincho --weight 900 resolves Noto Serif SC from the catalog (the case's query: 远灯守夜人雾岛群光路解谜); --style gothic for the label roles.
fonts.licence: All roles use SIL OFL 1.1 fonts.
fonts.lettering: The Latin name is the bank's code-drawn lettering, wide and square: width 0.78, stroke 0.2, chamfer 0, stencil 0.08, tracking 180, with a rust shadow plate.
fonts.note: Fonts are named, not bundled. --font-dir <dir> reads coverage and embeds the faces.

grammar: One monument from a worm's-eye view, large enough to leave the frame at the bottom; one beam of light as a flat paper wedge.
The title lives inside the light, on the beam's axis, tilted with it; the light widens where the title needs room (small capsule: nearly the whole frame).
Vermilion dominates (over half the frame); paper is the only light; ink only on the monument and the title.
Halftone eats the end of the light; no gradient, no glow blur.
The ink plate is a few pixels out of register over a rust plate: the misregistration is the texture.
One design, many sizes: re-compose every asset (monument foot and lantern, beam angle and spread, title distance and size) instead of cropping.

sizes.library hero: 3840x1240 (art only, key content in the centred 860x380)

steam.rules: Capsules carry art, the game name and an official subtitle only (Steam graphical asset rules, since 2022-09-01); the library hero has no text; screenshots must be real gameplay (at least 5).
steam.templates: steam.header-capsule, steam.small-capsule, steam.main-capsule, steam.vertical-capsule, steam.library-capsule, steam.event-cover, steam.event-header. The text-free assets (library hero, page background, icons, logo) stay example renders.

procedural: monument (layouts-litho.cjs tower()): a tapering shaft with paper bands, gallery, lantern and dome, ink plate shifted over a rust plate
beam: a paper wedge from the lantern; its last 15-45% eaten by vermilion dots in three sizes
halftone glow: three rings of dot pattern around the lantern
sea band with paper dashes, small boats
recipes: Halftone screens for print or a raster pass: materials generate --generator halftone --params '{"periodPx":18,"angleDeg":45,"coverage":0.35,"ink":"#D9441F"}' --seed 1.

Paper tooth over the whole asset, kept out of the title box: materials generate --generator paper --params '{"profile":"laid-cream","pxPerMm":4}' --seed 1, multiplied at 55% with a mask cut around the title.
A monument from a photograph: materials process --file <cut.png> --effect duotone --params '{"inks":["#15151C","#8E2A17"],"misregisterMm":[0.6,-0.4]}' --seed 1, then the monument slot.
collage: The only collage is your own monument (monument slot); it never sits under the title.
materials.sources: Everything is drawn; public-domain engravings (The Met, CC0) only for in-game mock-ups.

grammar: A size-adaptation reel cuts between assets on the beat; each asset holds 0.5-1 s; the beam sweeps once per cut.
The beam can rotate a few degrees between holds; the title stays inside it on every frame.

guidance: 64 px distinctiveness (guidance): hide the title, shrink to 64 px and set the header, vertical and small capsules side by side; they should read as one game and as a printed poster. A navy sky with an amber beam reads as 'any lighthouse game'.

Small capsule: downscale to 184x69 and 120x45 with Lanczos and read the title by eye (or OCR); keep the title box near 24 px at 120x45. OCR misses the tilted, slit title at large sizes: judge by eye, do not flatten the title for OCR.
Beam slits hide part of the title: they stay under the occlusion limit (three slits of 2.2-3.5% of the size).
checks.note: The browser check runs on every render (the title on the beam, its slits and the halftone are measured in pixels).

examples.note: Assets of the case that stay example renders (no text, or not a Steam capsule): see docs/cases/steam-capsules/ (README showcase).

renders.screen: library hero 3840x1240, page background 1438x810, shortcut and app icons, transparent library logo
renders.why: art-only or logo-only assets have no text to check; render them from the same parts (layouts-litho.cjs) when needed
